---
title: "Overall survival — preparation"
subtitle: "Locked 182-day survival endpoint"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)

source(here("R", "covariates.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "02-overall-survival", "01-main", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: prepare-os-data
#| include: false

prepared <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
) |>
  mutate(
    ecog_binary = derive_ecog_binary(ecog_fstcnt),
    mgps = derive_mgps(albumin, c_reactive_protein)
  ) |>
  # Column order sets the MICE visit sequence in the imputation notebook.
  select(
    id, tx, survival_time_days, event_death, ecog_binary,
    ecog_fstcnt, stage_binary, lung, mgps, age, gender,
    albumin, bilirubin, c_reactive_protein, lactate_dehydrogenase
  )

write_parquet(prepared, file.path(results_dir, "prepared.parquet"))
```
